Namaskaar Dosto, aaj baat karte hain Laptop vs Tablet ki – students ke liye kaunsa hai better choice? Online classes, note-taking, assignments, coding, productivity, entertainment, portability aur budget ke hisaab se kya khareedna rahega best? Iss video mein jaanenge dono ke advantages aur disadvantages, taaki aap le sakein ek smart decision. Chaliye Dosto, shuru karte hain!
